title: NormalBoomerang
description: This DataPack adds 7 boomerangs (modifiable and configurable ) to the basic Minecraft materials. Multiple translations are available, and you can add your own boomerangs.
body:

**Works alone and with friends Online** !!

**Configurable and customizable if you want to add your own boomerang!**
